card.name: Quote attribution to a news release
card.fires_on: The word after a researcher's name and title in a quote attribution, mostly 'release' or 'statement' after 'said in a news' or 'in a'. It also fires on verbs like saying or writing that introduce a quote.

modes.label: Release or statement
modes.description: Noun naming the source of a quote, such as a news release or statement.
modes.example: Crane explained in the news<< release>>. More research is needed to determine how

modes.label: Speech verbs and linking words
modes.description: Verb or small word in the attribution that leads into the quote.
modes.example: co-author Phil Smith was quoted as<< saying>> in a press release.

card.plain: It marks the spot where a news story says who made a quoted comment and through what channel, such as a press release.
